question: The Harshacharita is written in Sanskrit by _________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Banabhatta.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Banabhatta** one of the most accomplished writers in** Sanskrit** prose best known for his chronicle, **the Harshacharita**.
 
• He was **Harshavardhana's court poet**.
 
• The **biography of Harshvardhana** that he penned is known as the ''Harshacharita.' It was his first historical work.
 
• Harsha is known mainly through the works of Banabhatta named Harsacharita (“Deeds of Harsha&rdq
